name: HortResearch persimmon spatial analysis (2000)
description: An SIRC 2000 study associating persimmon fruit yield and quality with orchard locations and regional climate.
story: Alistair Mowat's SIRC 2000 paper linked two seasons of observations from 24 New Zealand persimmon orchards with geographic coordinates and regions. A self-organising-map analysis compared variations in fruit quality, productivity and climate.

The work illustrates agricultural research using explicit geographic information in statistical modelling. Its self-organising maps were analytical data projections, so the paper is evidence for spatial data analysis rather than evidence of a particular conventional desktop GIS product.
